# edx — School, together
> edx is a South African school-to-home communication app concept for grades 1–8.

This public build is an interactive demonstration using fictional school, educator, parent and pupil data. There is no real authentication, real-time messaging, authoritative school calendar or secure student-record storage in this release.

Key product areas:
- Home: school digest, homework and at-a-glance dates
- Updates: notices, subject updates and assignments
- Calendar: school events, tests and homework
- Inbox: school-family conversations and staff community concept

edx should not be used to store real learner information until school onboarding, access control, secure hosted storage, data protection review and operational controls are complete.
For background see /about.txt.
